decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core offer and has its own page, so it plausibly meets aspirations, and a growing, investing firm has the slack to keep it.
The apron connectivity module supports the integrated digital apron strategy, and with slack from expansion there is no performance shortfall pressing the firm to cut it this early.
Billing software is further from the core lighting and docking competence and only mentioned on the site, but it is too soon to judge it against aspirations, and slack allows the firm to carry it.
Equipment monitoring uses the firm's installed base and service expertise, fits the lifecycle services direction, and draws on few resources.
Resource management is close to the established offer and complements turnaround management, so it is likely to be kept.
The controller safety alert service builds on the tower and surveillance expertise and serves safety goals, so absent a shortfall the firm keeps it while results remain uncertain.
